channel.title: Pseudoscience Speelgoed
channel.description: An interactive thought experiment and constructed relational language by ScepraX. Explore bonds, echoes, thresholds, grief, and identity through the Pseudoscience Speelgoed framework and its AI-assisted Oracle.

item.title: The Planetary Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of a whole planet: its climate, oceans, ice, core and magnetic field, with Earth as the worked example for any world.

item.title: The Chemical Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of atoms, molecules, and the bonds between them, from Hydrogen and Oxygen to Water and Sugar.

item.title: The Veld in Motion
item.description: A living Instantie of the PseudoScience Speelgoed: Solos meet, Echoes lag, Drempels fire Vonken, the Van Motor never rests, and Rouw stays. Watch one Koppel up close, set the Vervorming, and see the Telraam close.

item.title: The Social Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of people and the bonds between them, from a single friendship to a whole society.

item.title: The Cellular Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of single cells and the bonds between them.

item.title: The Ecological Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of populations, communities, and ecosystems.

item.title: The Neuroscience Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of brains, behaviour, and the bonds between people.

item.title: The Echo of Origin: A PseudoScience Speelgoed Analysis of Locational Taste Enhancement
item.description: Why does cheese from the Netherlands lose its taste when taken to France? An application of the PseudoScience Speelgoed to why food tastes better in its region of origin.

item.title: The Thermodynamic Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one proposed instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of heat, work, and irreversibility.

item.title: The Cosmic Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — one proposed instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the scale of galaxies, spacetime, and the observable universe.

item.title: The Quantum Octaaf
item.description: Theoretical framework — not empirically confirmed. One proposed instantiation of the Speelgoed's primitives at the quantum scale.

item.title: MHD with Memory: A relaxation-time extension predicting a phase shift in Alfvén waves
item.description: A paper by M.J.A. Knippenberg (ScepraX) extending magnetohydrodynamics with a relaxation time in the turbulent electromotive force: Alfvén waves acquire frequency-dependent damping and a velocity–magnetic phase shift, and current solar data show why the effect is too small to detect yet.

item.title: An Introduction to Advanced Relational Studies — Newcomer's Guide
item.description: A plain-language introduction to how relationships work in this universe, written for a player who has never opened the technical model and never needs to. No maths required. No prior reading required.

item.title: PseudoScience Speelgoed — The Full Text
item.description: The complete PseudoScience Speelgoed as a single document: a language for bonds and an engine that runs them, built from five primitives (Eigen, Echo, Trouw, Drempel, Vonk) and one mechanism used at every scale.
